name: Aperio Microsoft 365
author: Aperio Contributors
description: Bundled Microsoft Graph adapter — Outlook calendars, Microsoft To Do tasks and Outlook contacts (Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online).

en.account.authority.hint: Must match your Azure app registration's "supported account types". Enter "common" for all Microsoft accounts (personal + work/school), "consumers" for personal Microsoft accounts only (outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com), "organizations" for work/school accounts only — or your tenant ID. "common" is usually right.
en.account.authority.label: Account type
en.account.client_id.hint: From the Azure portal (Entra ID → App registrations → your app → Application (client) ID). Register the app as type "Public client/native (mobile & desktop)" with redirect URI "http://localhost". It looks like 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc.
en.account.client_id.label: Microsoft Application (Client) ID

de.account.authority.hint: Muss zu deiner Azure-App-Registrierung passen — „Supported account types". Trage „common" ein für alle Microsoft-Konten (privat + geschäftlich), „consumers" für nur private Microsoft-Konten (outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com), „organizations" für nur Schul- / Arbeitskonten — oder die ID deines Tenants. „common" ist meist die richtige Wahl.
de.account.authority.label: Konto-Typ
de.account.client_id.hint: Aus dem Azure-Portal (Entra ID → App registrations → deine App → Application (client) ID). Lege die App als Typ „Public client/native (mobile & desktop)" an, Redirect-URI auf „http://localhost". Sie sieht aus wie 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc.
de.account.client_id.label: Microsoft Application (Client) ID
